sources.title: hotl utility
claimsUsed: An HDA is a binary archive that may contain one or more asset definitions, metadata and arbitrary sections.
Packed and expanded forms are alternative containers for the same asset library.
Expanded output separates library metadata, asset metadata, definition contents and sections.

sources.title: Working with files and assets as text
claimsUsed: An asset library can be converted between binary and expanded forms.
Expanded internal formats are undocumented and may change, so direct format-dependent normalization is unsafe.

sources.title: hou.HDASection
claimsUsed: A definition is stored in multiple named sections.
Special sections store node contents and parameter definitions, while arbitrary sections can be referenced as files.
Section content can be read as text or binary bytes independently of compression.

sources.title: hou.HDADefinition
claimsUsed: HOM exposes all definition sections, uncompressed Contents, options, interface and type identity separately.
Definition modification time and library path are metadata, not immutable content identity.

independence: One official SideFX documentation lineage; source authority does not create independent runtime evidence.
